name: Hero Mascot
rationale: Pip takes centre stage above bold dimensional arcade lettering, with coral wing bursts and stars making the push-up-powered adventure feel joyful and instantly familiar.

name: Winglift Monogram
rationale: A rising P becomes the wing while a rounded B becomes Pip’s profile, joining playful initials with a bright beak and a warm, compact wordmark.

name: Sky Passport
rationale: A scalloped passport seal turns Pip’s flights around the world into a collectible travel badge, with warm ink lettering and a coral globe.

name: Island Adventure
rationale: A warm storybook wordmark rests on a floating grassy island, with Pip perched above and a faceted rock point giving the game an unmistakable adventure silhouette.

name: Star Slingshot
rationale: A sweeping comet trajectory launches Pip past tilted arcade lettering, turning the game’s star trails into a bold symbol of lift and momentum.

name: Cloud Letterplay
rationale: Bespoke cloud-shaped BIRD lettering becomes the emblem itself, with Peaches peeking through the B and a coral Push-Up capsule floating in the sky.
theme: Soft toy lettering, cloud cruise, Peaches

name: Pixel Power
rationale: A true grid-built arcade wordmark and cheerful pixel Pip turn the movement game into a collectible 8-bit adventure.
typography: Hand-drawn 5×7 pixel glyphs, fully editable vector geometry

name: Flock Friends
rationale: Pip, Minty, Peaches and Orbit huddle above a bold rising wordmark, turning the playable roster into a warm four-color sticker emblem.

name: Wing Medal
rationale: Pip becomes a smiling gold achievement coin between stepped flight wings, with a coral prize ribbon giving the game a collectible arcade identity.

name: Orbit After Dark
rationale: Orbit becomes a crescent bird encircled by a fine gold planetary ring, giving the arcade title a dreamy, collectible night-sky identity.

name: Motion Ribbon
rationale: A continuous coral ribbon curls through an exercise loop into an ascending bird, paired with a slanted, buoyant game wordmark.
theme: Sporty playful motion, repetition and upward flight

name: Feather Script
rationale: Flowing brushlike script and a feather hyphen turn the title into an airy signature, with a rising coral swash carrying the arcade energy toward a star.

name: Minty Lift
rationale: Two interlocking mint wings form an uplifting little bird, with an upward arrow cut through their meeting point and a warm rounded lowercase wordmark.
theme: Scandinavian toy brand / geometric arcade bird

name: Gate Dash
rationale: A park gate becomes the emblem: Pip shoots between mint pillars while the title forms its sturdy teal crossbar and a coral pennant signals arcade adventure.

name: Paper Flight
rationale: Folded crown, layered wing and offset lettering give the joyful yellow bird the tactile character of a premium cut-paper arcade title.

name: Comic Pop
rationale: A staggered, oversized comic wordmark erupts from a yellow halftone blast, with Pip’s eye and beak hidden in the B.

name: Negative-Space Feather
rationale: A soft ink feather reveals a cheerful little bird raising one wing in its cream cutout, pairing a memorable stamp silhouette with a quietly playful coral accent.

name: Bounce Spring
rationale: A wide-eyed yellow bird rebounds above a bold coral U-shaped toy spring, turning physical movement into a cheerful arcade identity.

name: Sunburst Flight Club
rationale: A smooth retro sun and swift bird silhouette rise above a broad winged ribbon, giving the arcade name the optimism of a mid-century adventure poster.

name: Updraft
rationale: One airy flight line embraces the name, loops into a heart, and climbs into an ascending yellow bird, making movement feel joyful and effortless.
theme: Continuous flight path and upward motion
